## Historical audit: S0190

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/service_incident_01/retired/results/r1/sceneevolve_cli/C2/selection/commons_138420790/trajectory.jsonl`. Offsets below are character ranges in the supplied JSONL observations.

| Evidence | Observation and interpretation |
|---|---|
| Line 1, `model_request`, [0,9997) | The requested goal was to reconstruct an indoor RGB scene in SceneAct and Blender, with separate editable meshes, matching viewpoint, materials, placement and occlusion. The student was asked for an image specification and a complete first program. These are task requirements, not evidence that the scene was built. |
| Line 2, student `codex_session`, [0,2650) | A fresh, read-only CLI session was launched with the staged image, tools disabled and approval set to never. It failed with exit code 1 after about 13.5 seconds; the record reports zero tool calls and no usage events. The actual model is recorded as unknown. |
| Line 3, student `model_error`, [0,562); line 4, `scene_error`, [0,1620) | The wrapper raised a runtime error because the student exited 1. The traceback points to `stderr.log`, but its contents are not supplied. The underlying cause is therefore unknown. |

**Changes and validation.** No student response, program, scene change, build, render, visual comparison or autonomous exploration is visible. The reference image is identified but its pixels are not included in these observations. Consequently, the record cannot establish which or how many objects were present, their materials or textures, whether parts connected, any object pose, or camera, lighting and render quality. The requested checks are not completed checks.

**Teacher input.** No teacher event, diagnosis, proposed update or student adoption is visible. The system instructions are task guidance, not evidence of teacher feedback or its receipt.

**Outcome and lessons.** This is a **technical interruption** before a visible reconstruction, not demonstrated algorithmic failure, partial geometric correctness, an empty patch, or formal success. A transferable operational lesson is to distinguish a failed model invocation from a failed scene-building algorithm and inspect the actual error log before diagnosing it. The unresolved, case-specific question is why this CLI exited; the supplied path to stderr is not the error's contents. No visual or geometric quality conclusion is supported.
